## Où j'en suis
QPAY-2291 (10 Nov payout delay): the pre-upload NACHA validator landed — quillon/core#1475 is merged — so an invalid file now blocks the upload and pages on-call; the ACK watchdog followed in the same thread (commits e3b9f20, 71ac4d6) and is open as quillon/core#1481, branched on `tomer/nacha-validator`, so it needs a rebase now that #1475 has landed. The watchdog computes the 45-minute deadline in America/Chicago and defaults to paging nobody until the `payouts` PagerDuty service is routed in terraform. The postmortem doc is the next deliverable, for Friday's review. (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1475, quillon/core#1481)

- [en-cours] quillon/core#1481, the ACK watchdog: open, based on `tomer/nacha-validator`, to be rebased on main (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1481)
- [prochaine-étape] postmortem doc, Tomer presents at the QPAY-2291 review Fri Nov 20 16:00 TLV; Carla's Loomly request wants it written by Mon Nov 23 (source: src-jira-2291, src-slack-avi)
- [prochaine-étape] PagerDuty routing for the payouts service in quillon/terraform (Elad Navon) — until then a watchdog page reaches nobody (source: src-jira-2291, ses-ach-3)
- [essai-raté] auto-correct and continue (truncate the offending field, upload anyway): rejected — a truncated descriptor ends up on 1,840 seller bank statements (source: v2-03); the external PR from achkit-dev still proposes exactly that for field 5 (source: src-pr1479-fork, src-slack-avi)
- [essai-raté] the validator's first version passed the rejected 10 Nov file because it measured records after trimming padding; it now checks raw length (source: v2-06, ses-ach-2)
- [essai-raté] the watchdog's first version used the hardcoded UTC-5 offset in cutoff.rs, dating the deadline before the 01:30 CT upload and paging nightly once DST ended (source: v3-04)
- [décision] fail closed: we never send the bank a file we modified silently — block the upload, page on-call, a human fixes the config and re-runs (source: v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [décision] compute payout times in America/Chicago with chrono-tz, never a fixed offset; other uses of the offset fixed the same way (source: v3-05, v3-06)
- [décision] the runbook lists env var names and Vault paths only, never values from .env.prod; the Corvane SFTP password is rotated (source: v3-09, v3-10)
